text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Sweet potatoes are all cut! Next was... 
glutinous rice, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Chiyono O has a Qi-deficient 
constitution, so foods that 'tonify Qi' 
would be best...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ingredients that nourish the blood for 
blood deficiency, right? In that case, 
maybe I'll go with simmered hijiki♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
In that case... adding black soybeans 
might make it even better...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chitose-san! I'm in such high spirits, I 
feel like I could eat anything and 
everything! What should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... Wholesome and good. Let us 
share a portion from everyone's trays...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Today's medicinal dish is ready~! The 
simmered hijiki seaweed looks delicious 
too, doesn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Well then... once it cools down, shall we 
pack it into the bento boxes in order...?

Coming to the cafeteria during lunch 
break, I spotted the Umamusume from the 
Victory Club gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Now then... let us offer our gratitude for 
the blessings of heaven today—

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

Dishes they seemingly cooked themselves 
are plated. Made with so many ingredients, 
it's, well――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Rice, leafy greens, blue-backed 
fish――hmm…… It seems your "qi" and "blood" 
are well-nourished……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
In that case......――thou there. Care 
for... a slice of lotus root?
choice_data_list: Huh... for me? Are you sure?
Huh... for me? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Replenishing your 'Water' with this 
should do well...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just as the name implies, it refers to 
hydration. That's the terminology used in 
traditional herbal medicine and dietary 
therapy♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Chitose-chan is quite knowledgeable about 
medicinal cuisine. I'm sure she figured 
out what you were missing just by looking 
at your meals, Trainer-san♪

I thanked them and decided to accept a 
piece of simmered lotus root.
choice_data_list: It tastes like it's good for you.
Tastes like it's good for you.

text_block_list.text:
I thanked them and decided to accept a 
piece of simmered lotus root.
choice_data_list: It tastes like it's good for you.
Tastes like it's good for you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Ho ho ho— Good, very good...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Inner fulfillment, too…… leads to peace of 
mind and robust health……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Ho ho ho— Indeed... Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Good medicine tastes bitter, yet benefits 
the ailment―― The very same principle 
applies to food...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"Medicine and food share the same 
origin"――Food is medicine, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
If one's daily diet is in order, good 
fortune will naturally follow…… Hohoho……
